cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I copied your crosses on the two eight-o'clock invitations. Pick the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My crosses mean declined. You've cancelled both.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, room to decide. Which invitation shall I accept again?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ceremony. We'll move dinner until afterward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll accept the ceremony and leave our eight-o'clock table cancelled. Tell me that's the choice you're making.

reason: Give S04 a particular misunderstood imitation which changes the Drive tactic. Preserve responsive B turns and explicitly stated essential facts; remove generic confidence prefaces.
